statements.statement: SELECT JOB_QUEUE_NAME, JOB_QUEUE_LIBRARY, JOB_QUEUE_STATUS, NUMBER_OF_JOBS, JOB_QUEUE_TYPE FROM QSYS2.JOB_QUEUE_INFO
SELECT SPOOLED_FILE_NAME, JOB_NAME, JOB_USER, JOB_NUMBER, OUTPUT_QUEUE, OUTPUT_QUEUE_LIBRARY, SPOOLED_FILE_STATUS, NUMBER_OF_PAGES, USER_DATA FROM QSYS2.OUTPUT_QUEUE_INFO WHERE 1=1
SELECT JOB_NUMBER, JOB_NAME, JOB_USER, JOB_STATUS, FUNCTION_TYPE, SUBSYSTEM, MEMORY_POOL FROM QSYS2.ACTIVE_JOB_INFO
SELECT JOB_NUMBER, JOB_NAME, JOB_USER, MESSAGE_TEXT FROM QSYS2.MESSAGE_QUEUE_INFO

SELECT JOB_NAME, JOB_USER, JOB_NUMBER, MESSAGE_ID, MESSAGE_TEXT, MESSAGE_TYPE, SENDING_PROGRAM_NAME, DATE_SENT, TIME_SENT FROM QSYS2.MESSAGE_QUEUE_INFO WHERE MESSAGE_STATUS = 'READY' AND MESSAGE_TYPE IN ('ESCAPE', 'INQUIRY')
SELECT USER_NAME, GROUP_PROFILE, STATUS FROM QSYS2.USER_INFO WHERE USER_NAME = ?
SELECT USER_NAME, STATUS, GROUP_PROFILE, TEXT_DESCRIPTION, LAST_USED_DATE FROM QSYS2.USER_INFO ORDER BY USER_NAME FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
SELECT USER_NAME, STATUS, GROUP_PROFILE, TEXT_DESCRIPTION, LAST_USED_DATE, PASSWORD_EXPIRE_DATE FROM QSYS2.USER_INFO WHERE USER_NAME = ?
SELECT AUTHORIZATION_NAME, GROUP_PROFILE_NAME FROM QSYS2.USER_INFO ORDER BY AUTHORIZATION_NAME
SELECT DISTINCT TABLE_SCHEMA FROM QSYS2.SYSTABLES WHERE FILE_TYPE = 'S' AND TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('QSYS2','QTEMP','QSYS','QGPL') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA
SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM QSYS2.SYSTABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND FILE_TYPE = 'S' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME
SELECT MEMBER_NAME FROM QSYS2.SYSMEMBER WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND TABLE_NAME = ? ORDER BY MEMBER_NAME
SELECT MEMBER_DEFINITION FROM QSYS2.SYSMEMBER WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND TABLE_NAME = ? AND MEMBER_NAME = ?
SELECT OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, OBJECT_LIBRARY, OBJECT_SIZE, OBJECT_CREATION_TIMESTAMP FROM QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS WHERE OBJECT_LIBRARY = ?

SELECT OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, OBJECT_LIBRARY, OBJECT_SIZE, OBJECT_CREATION_TIMESTAMP, OBJECT_CHANGE_TIMESTAMP, OBJECT_TEXT_DESCRIPTION, OBJECT_OWNER, ASP_NAME FROM QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS WHERE OBJECT_LIBRARY = ? AND OBJECT_NAME = ?

SELECT OBJECT_LIBRARY, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, REF_OBJ_LIBRARY, REF_OBJ_NAME, REF_OBJ_TYPE FROM QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS WHERE OBJECT_LIBRARY = ? AND OBJECT_NAME = ? AND REF_OBJ_NAME IS NOT NULL FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
SELECT OBJECT_LIBRARY, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, REF_OBJ_LIBRARY, REF_OBJ_NAME, REF_OBJ_TYPE FROM QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS WHERE REF_OBJ_LIBRARY = ? AND REF_OBJ_NAME = ? FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
SELECT AUTHORITY_HOLDER, AUTHORITY_HOLDER_TYPE, AUTHORITY FROM QSYS2.OBJECT_PRIVILEGES WHERE OBJECT_SCHEMA = ? AND OBJECT_NAME = ?
SELECT OBJECT_LIBRARY, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, OBJECT_SIZE, OBJECT_CREATION_TIMESTAMP FROM QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS WHERE OBJECT_LIBRARY = ? AND OBJECT_TYPE = '*STMF'
SELECT TABLE_NAME, TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_TEXT FROM QSYS2.SYSTABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND FILE_TYPE = 'D' AND TABLE_TYPE = 'T' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME
SELECT COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_TYPE, LENGTH, NULLABLE FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND TABLE_NAME = ? ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
SELECT * FROM {lib}.{tbl}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM {lib}.{tbl}
SELECT DATA_SPACE_SIZE, NUMBER_MEMBERS FROM QSYS2.SYSTABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND TABLE_NAME = ?
SELECT INDEX_NAME FROM QSYS2.SYSINDEXES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND TABLE_NAME = ?
SELECT NUMBER_MEMBERS FROM QSYS2.SYSTABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND TABLE_NAME = ?
SELECT DATA_AREA_LIBRARY, DATA_AREA_NAME, DATA_AREA_TYPE, DATA_AREA_LENGTH, DATA_AREA_VALUE, DATA_AREA_DESCRIPTION FROM QSYS2.DATA_AREA_INFO WHERE DATA_AREA_LIBRARY = ? FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
SELECT DATA_AREA_LIBRARY, DATA_AREA_NAME, DATA_AREA_TYPE, DATA_AREA_LENGTH, DATA_AREA_VALUE, DATA_AREA_DESCRIPTION FROM QSYS2.DATA_AREA_INFO WHERE DATA_AREA_LIBRARY = ? AND DATA_AREA_NAME = ?
SELECT SUBSYSTEM_NAME, SUBSYSTEM_DESCRIPTION, STATUS, ACTIVE_JOBS, MAX_ACTIVE_JOBS FROM QSYS2.SUBSYSTEM_INFO
SELECT SUBSYSTEM_NAME, SUBSYSTEM_DESCRIPTION, STATUS, NUMBER_OF_ACTIVE_JOBS, MAXIMUM_ACTIVE_JOBS, SUBSYSTEM_LIBRARY FROM QSYS2.SUBSYSTEM_INFO
SELECT SYSTEM_VALUE_NAME, CURRENT_VALUE, VALUE_DESCRIPTION, SYSTEM_VALUE_TYPE FROM QSYS2.SYSTEM_VALUE_INFO
SELECT MESSAGE_FILE_NAME, MESSAGE_FILE_LIBRARY, NUMBER_OF_MESSAGES, MESSAGE_FILE_TEXT FROM QSYS2.MESSAGE_FILE_INFO WHERE MESSAGE_FILE_LIBRARY = ? FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
SELECT MESSAGE_ID, MESSAGE_TEXT, SECOND_LEVEL_TEXT, SEVERITY FROM QSYS2.MESSAGE_DESCRIPTION_INFO WHERE MESSAGE_FILE_LIBRARY = ? AND MESSAGE_FILE_NAME = ?

SELECT OBJECT_LIBRARY, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, REF_OBJ_LIBRARY, REF_OBJ_NAME, REF_OBJ_TYPE FROM QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS WHERE OBJECT_LIBRARY = ? AND REF_OBJ_NAME IS NOT NULL FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY
SELECT MESSAGE_FILE_NAME, MESSAGE_FILE_LIBRARY, NUMBER_OF_MESSAGES, MESSAGE_FILE_TEXT FROM QSYS2.MESSAGE_FILE_INFO
SELECT MESSAGE_ID, MESSAGE_TEXT, SECOND_LEVEL_TEXT, SEVERITY FROM QSYS2.MESSAGE_FILE_ENTRY WHERE MESSAGE_FILE_NAME = ? AND MESSAGE_FILE_LIBRARY = ?
SELECT USER_NAME, STATUS, GROUP_PROFILE, TEXT_DESCRIPTION, LAST_USED_DATE, PASSWORD_EXPIRE_DATE FROM QSYS2.USER_INFO WHERE 1=1
SELECT ORDINAL_POSITION, MESSAGE_ID, MESSAGE_TYPE, MESSAGE_TEXT, MESSAGE_TIMESTAMP FROM TABLE(QSYS2.JOBLOG_INFO('JOB', ?, '*JOBLOG')) X ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
SELECT MESSAGE_ID, MESSAGE_TYPE, MESSAGE_TEXT, REPLY_STATUS FROM TABLE(QSYS2.MESSAGE_QUEUE_INFO('*JOB', ?)) X WHERE REPLY_STATUS = 'MSGW'

SELECT JOB_NUMBER, JOB_NAME, JOB_USER, MIN(MESSAGE_TIMESTAMP) AS START_TS, MAX(MESSAGE_TIMESTAMP) AS END_TS FROM TABLE(QSYS2.JOB_LOG_INFO(JOB_NAME_FILTER => '*ALL', JOB_USER_FILTER => '*ALL', JOB_NUMBER_FILTER => '*ALL')) X GROUP BY JOB_NUMBER, JOB_NAME, JOB_USER ORDER BY END_TS DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

SELECT JOB_NUMBER, JOB_NAME, JOB_USER, MESSAGE_TEXT FROM TABLE(QSYS2.JOB_LOG_INFO(JOB_NAME_FILTER => '*ALL', JOB_USER_FILTER => '*ALL', JOB_NUMBER_FILTER => '*ALL', MESSAGE_ID_FILTER => 'CPF1124')) X FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
SELECT JOB_NAME, JOB_USER, JOB_NUMBER, MESSAGE_ID, MESSAGE_TEXT, MESSAGE_TIMESTAMP, SEVERITY_NUMBER FROM TABLE(QSYS2.HISTORY_LOG_INFO(JOB_NAME_FILTER => '*ALL')) X WHERE 1=1
SELECT ORDINAL_POSITION, MESSAGE_ID, MESSAGE_TYPE, MESSAGE_TEXT, MESSAGE_TIMESTAMP FROM QSYS2.MESSAGE_QUEUE_INFO WHERE MESSAGE_QUEUE_NAME = ? AND MESSAGE_QUEUE_LIBRARY = ? ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
SELECT MESSAGE_ID, MESSAGE_TYPE, MESSAGE_TEXT, REPLY_STATUS FROM QSYS2.MESSAGE_QUEUE_INFO WHERE MESSAGE_QUEUE_NAME = ? AND MESSAGE_QUEUE_LIBRARY = ? AND MESSAGE_STATUS = 'READY'
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TEXT FROM QSYS2.SYSTABLES WHERE 1=1

SELECT ORDINAL_POSITION, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, LENGTH, SCALE, IS_NULLABLE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, COLUMN_DEFAULT, COLUMN_TEXT FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND TABLE_NAME = ? ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM {lib}.{tbl} WHERE 1=1
SELECT * FROM {lib}.{tbl} WHERE 1=1
SELECT * FROM QSYS2.ASP_INFO
SELECT CPU_UTILIZATION FROM QSYS2.SYSTEM_STATUS_INFO
SELECT ASP_NAME, TOTAL_SPACE, USED_SPACE FROM QSYS2.ASP_INFO
SELECT MAIN_STORAGE_USED_PERCENT FROM QSYS2.SYSTEM_STATUS_INFO
SELECT LOCAL_ADDRESS, REMOTE_ADDRESS, STATE FROM QSYS2.NETSTAT_INFO
SELECT OUTPUT_QUEUE, OUTPUT_QUEUE_LIBRARY, SPOOLED_FILE_STATUS FROM QSYS2.OUTPUT_QUEUE_INFO
SELECT JOB_NAME FROM TABLE(QSYS2.ACTIVE_JOB_INFO()) X
SELECT JOB_NAME FROM TABLE(QSYS2.ACTIVE_JOB_INFO()) X WHERE JOB_STATUS = 'MSGW'
SELECT JOB_NAME FROM TABLE(QSYS2.ACTIVE_JOB_INFO()) X WHERE JOB_STATUS = 'LCKW'
SELECT ASP_NAME, TOTAL_SPACE, USED_SPACE, AVAILABLE_SPACE FROM QSYS2.ASP_INFO
